utterance: Our VPC `app-vpc` (10.0.0.0/16) already exists, with the shared segment 10.0.0.0/24 carved out of it. Carve out a subnet for 10.0.1.0/24 and control both its ingress and its egress traffic with a network ACL associated with that subnet, so that the ACL governing the subnet allows inbound TCP port 80 from 10.3.0.0/18 and outbound TCP port 443 to 10.3.0.0/18.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: the pre-existing VPC 10.0.0.0/16 has a subnet for 10.0.1.0/24, and the network ACL that subnet is associated with allows inbound TCP 80 from 10.3.0.0/18 and outbound TCP 443 to 10.3.0.0/18
